vocabulary.label: Punch
vocabulary.cutBehavior: short hard emphasis on strong sync points
vocabulary.textBehavior: hero word lands at the accent with minimal pre-roll
vocabulary.cameraBehavior: fast push or snap-shake resolves inside the beat
vocabulary.sfxBehavior: single impact or whoosh with tight ducking
vocabulary.backgroundBehavior: brief contrast kick without stealing focus

vocabulary.label: Hold
vocabulary.cutBehavior: withhold cuts across a breath window
vocabulary.textBehavior: text arrives late and stays calm
vocabulary.sfxBehavior: no accent unless a phrase needs support

vocabulary.label: Bloom
vocabulary.cutBehavior: cut after the idea opens rather than on first contact
vocabulary.textBehavior: phrase expands from support to hero emphasis
vocabulary.sfxBehavior: soft riser or rounded impact follows the phrase
vocabulary.backgroundBehavior: light or atmosphere opens behind the focal layer

vocabulary.label: Ratchet
vocabulary.cutBehavior: successive cuts shorten spacing as tension rises
vocabulary.textBehavior: successive words increase hierarchy and urgency
vocabulary.cameraBehavior: push, dutch, or shake stacks with rising intensity
vocabulary.sfxBehavior: riser, whoosh, and impact cadence escalates in order
vocabulary.backgroundBehavior: motion density increases but remains below text

vocabulary.label: Glide
vocabulary.textBehavior: support copy moves with the camera instead of popping
vocabulary.backgroundBehavior: background cycle continues through the release

vocabulary.label: Suspend
vocabulary.cutBehavior: delay the next cut to create tension
vocabulary.textBehavior: hold or reduce text before the next accent
vocabulary.cameraBehavior: freeze or nearly freeze the frame
vocabulary.sfxBehavior: silence, low riser, or sub pressure before release
vocabulary.backgroundBehavior: lower movement and pull contrast inward

vocabulary.label: Detonate
vocabulary.cutBehavior: spend the strongest cut at the final release
vocabulary.textBehavior: CTA or thesis word lands as a decisive hero
vocabulary.sfxBehavior: impact and sub-drop spend the climax budget
vocabulary.backgroundBehavior: background accent peaks then clears for readability
